name: mjavmjav
description: Mjav mjav: a browser-based cat soundboard for mjavmjav.com.

scripts.check: bun run check:html && bun run check:js && bun run check:config
scripts.check:html: bun -e "const s=await Bun.file('public/index.html').text(); if(!s.includes('<main')||!s.includes('soundboard')) throw new Error('index.html checks failed')"
scripts.check:js: bun -e "const s=await Bun.file('public/app.js').text(); if(!s.includes('AudioContext')||!s.includes('prefers-reduced-motion')) throw new Error('app.js checks failed')"
scripts.check:config: bun -e "const c=await Bun.file('wrangler.jsonc').text(); if(!c.includes('mjavmjav')) throw new Error('wrangler config checks failed')"
